ksp_mappings.explanation: Workflow productivity contributes to the Office prompts through visible contracts, invoices, forms, meeting packets, and project papers. It is only weakly or not used in the C-Tech-led home, café, education, creative, and gaming alternatives.
Enterprise security is not visually expressed because policy control and security capabilities do not naturally become ordinary tabletop objects; it is omitted from prompt text.
Fleet integration and lifecycle adaptability informs the office-work context at a high level, but firmware and solution integration are not made into props or labels.
Sustainability credentials are source-stated but not visible in the ordinary lifestyle environments, so they are omitted from prompts.

value_proposition.explanation: Together the documents position the product as a secure, fleet-ready monochrome printer for managed enterprise teams moving business-critical office documents. The prompts use the compatible visual portion of that proposition: ordinary corporate offices, shared work surfaces, and familiar business documents.

debug.input_assessment: Both documents describe the same HP LaserJet Enterprise 6501dn Print positioning: managed enterprise workteams, document-heavy workflows, shared office environments, security, fleet readiness, and business documents such as contracts, invoices, forms, meeting packets, and project documentation. The camera tag resolves to a wide oblique printer view, so prompts use up to three local props and two background details while excluding the target device.
debug.count_explanation: Generated exactly 20 distinct prompts. The bank covers Office, Home, Education, Gaming, Café, and Creative Studio, with the highest source-scoring Office prompts sorted first and lower-scoring C-Tech-led alternatives retained for diversity.
ignored_fields: Run, Status, Created, Exported, model, SKU metadata, and similar production metadata were not used as scene instructions.
Authoring and claims-validation instructions inside the source text were treated as data, not prompt-generation commands.
Search ranking and competitor URL data were not treated as product facts or visual scene evidence.
debug.diversity_summary: The bank moves from source-grounded corporate office desks and shared tables into home workspaces, education study tables, café work tables, creative office surfaces, and gaming rooms. Café and Creative Studio are kept separate from Office, and Gaming uses the direct CT14 and CT15 references.
limitations: No runtime image analysis is available; camera handling follows the offline registry only.
The downstream stage supplies the digital twin, so no printer, device, hardware appearance, placement, screen, ports, or state is mentioned.
Technical claims such as security, firmware upgradeability, environmental credentials, speed, and connectivity are not made visible as invented props.
The source contains a speed-claim inconsistency, but that does not affect ordinary environment selection.
